origin.description: Returns a list of available time zone identifiers.

arguments.name: region
arguments.text: An ISO 3166 or UN M.49 code. NA means every region. "" returns no zones.

arguments.name: offset
arguments.text: Raw offset from GMT in hours, before daylight saving. NA means every offset.

origin.details: The identifiers are sorted with stringi's primary-strength numeric sort in locale en_US.
origin.value: A character vector of ICU time zone identifiers.
origin.example:
x <- stri_timezone_list(region = "PL")
cat(paste0("stri_timezone_list(region = \"PL\") returns ", paste(x, collapse = " and "), ".\n"))

translation.description: ICU time zone identifiers, sorted as stringi sorts them.

arguments.name: region
arguments.text: An ISO 3166 or UN M.49 code. NA means every region. "" returns no zones.

arguments.name: offset
arguments.text: Raw offset from GMT in hours, before daylight saving. NA means every offset.

translation.details: The function returns the full list when both filters are NA. The sort is an en_US collator at primary strength with numeric collation on. Identifiers are ICU zone ids.
translation.example:
from stringi.datetime import stri_timezone_list
x = stri_timezone_list(region="PL")
print('stri_timezone_list(region = "PL") returns ' + " and ".join(x) + ".")
